Definition: Merajoth, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Meraioth = "rebellious"; 1) grandfather of Ahitub, descendant of Eleazar the son of Aaron, and the head of a priestly house; 2) son of Ahitub, father of Zadok, descendant of Eleazar the son of Aaron, and the head of a priestly house; 3) head of a family of priests represented by Helkai in the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua
